glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.unedasiss: UNEDasiss — a system of the Spanish distance university UNED that provides international applicants with services for university admission (credential evaluation, academic aptitude test).
glossary.pce: PCE (Prueba de Competencias Específicas) — subject-specific tests offered by UNED for international applicants who wish to improve their university admissions score in Spain.
glossary.ects: ECTS (European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System) — a standard unit for measuring academic workload across European universities. One academic year is typically 60 ECTS.
glossary.dele: DELE (Diplomas de Español como Lengua Extranjera) — official Spanish language certification issued by Instituto Cervantes. A permanent diploma with no expiry date.
glossary.siele: SIELE (Servicio Internacional de Evaluación de la Lengua Española) — a digital, multi-level Spanish language certification system. Valid for 5 years; scores reported on a 1,000-point scale.

upis-fakulteta.title: How to enrol in a university in Spain?
upis-fakulteta.excerpt: The process involves choosing a programme, checking admission requirements, preparing documentation, and tracking deadlines. Here is where to start.

unedasiss.title: What is UNEDasiss and who needs it?
unedasiss.excerpt: UNEDasiss is not a one-size-fits-all requirement. Whether you need it depends on your home education system and the specific university you are applying to.

pce-priprema.title: What is PCE and how do you prepare?
pce-priprema.excerpt: The right question is not 'how do I pass PCE?' but 'which PCE subjects do I actually need?' Start with the right question.

troskovi-studija.title: How much do studies and student life in Spain cost?
troskovi-studija.excerpt: The national average is around €15.37 per ECTS credit at public universities, but city and lifestyle choices matter just as much as tuition fees.

dele-ili-siele.title: DELE or SIELE — which exam should you choose?
dele-ili-siele.excerpt: DELE is a permanent diploma with no expiry. SIELE is a digital multi-level system valid for five years. The choice depends on what you need the certificate for.

nivo-spanskog.title: How to assess your Spanish level?
nivo-spanskog.excerpt: A level is a starting point for a plan, not a label. A proper assessment covers reading, listening, grammar, writing, and speaking — not just films you understand.

koji-grad.title: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia or Málaga — which city is right for you?
koji-grad.excerpt: There is no single best city for every student. It depends on your budget, your studies, your lifestyle, and your priorities.

smestaj.title: How to find accommodation in Spain?
smestaj.excerpt: Location is part of the decision, not just price. A room 100 € cheaper may not be cheaper if it adds two hours of commuting per day.

prvi-jezicki-kamp.title: What to know before your child's first language camp?
prvi-jezicki-kamp.excerpt: Do not choose a camp only by the city or the photos. Here is what to check first — and what your child should know before they leave.

pet-stvari-spanija.title: Five things you only notice after spending real time in Spain
pet-stvari-spanija.excerpt: The first visit stays with the sights and food. A longer stay brings an entirely different view. There is always a version of Spain you have not yet discovered.

prvi-boravak-madrid.title: My first time in Madrid — what I would do differently today
prvi-boravak-madrid.excerpt: The most I learned was when I had to figure things out on my own. That experience later became central to how I work with students.

zasto-elite-education.title: Why I started Elite Education
zasto-elite-education.excerpt: Not to process applications, but to be the place where someone can arrive with 'I want to go to Spain, but I don't know where to start' and leave with a clear next step.
